::: {style=""}

Since October 2024, I am a post-doc researcher in the team-project [MIMESIS](http://mimesis.inria.fr) at [Centre Inria de l'Université de Lorraine](https://www.inria.fr/fr/centre-inria-universite-lorraine), in Strasbourg 🥨 France.  

My current work is about **a posteriori error estimation** and **adaptive mesh refinement** for the **immersed boundary method** called <a href="https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/19m1248947" target=_blank>$\varphi$-FEM</a>.
As a member of MIMESIS my work aims at providing numerical tools for **biomecanics and biomedical simulations**.

#### Generative AI disclaimer


::: {layout="[1,3]" layout-valign="center"}

![](images/image-572.png){width=400}

::: {style=""}

I am strongly opposed to the use of frontier generative AI models (chatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral and so on...), therefore all the work I produce by myself (such as this website) is generative AI-free.

If you are wondering why, you can find hereafter a melting-pot of writings explaining (mostly) my position on genAI (I plan to write my own post one day when I find some time). My position does not align exactly with everything that is written in this list but has a non-empty intersection with each one of these items.
